svg.text: Heran fan 5 V build - hole placement (7x3 cm, 24 x 10 holes)
SUGGESTED placement - verify footprints vs YOUR parts. Dashed = back-side jumper. Net list in BUILD_GUIDE 2e is authoritative.
ESP + buck are modules on headers; the DIP, PC817 (DIP-4), resistors and 1uF sit in the grid. 74HC125 -> run buck ~4.4 V.
PWM-ctrl / PWM-mot / +24V / GND / SW5 go off-board to CN2 (see 2b/2e). Routing lanes auto-verified: no two nets overlap.
